SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board board JOIN users users ON users.user_id = board.user_id LEFT JOIN profile_files profiles ON profiles.user_id = users.user_id LEFT JOIN board_files boardFiles ON board.id = boardFiles.board_id AND boardFiles.type = 'FEATURE' WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED'
AND place LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchFilter.filter.place}, '%')
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchFilter.filter.titleOrContent}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchFilter.filter.titleOrContent}, '%'))
AND category = #{searchFilter.filter.category}
AND board.id IN (SELECT board_id FROM board_tags WHERE
tag LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tag}, '%')
)
AND ( board.visibility = 'PUBLIC' OR board.visibility = 'FOLLOW' AND board.user_id IN ( SELECT follow.following_id FROM follow follow WHERE follow.follower_id = #{userId} ) )

SELECT board.status AS status, board.visibility AS visibility, board.user_id AS userId, boardFiles.path AS path FROM board_files boardFiles JOIN board board ON boardFiles.board_id = board.id WHERE boardFiles.id = #{fileId}

SELECT board.id AS boardId, board.title AS title, board.content AS content, board.content_html AS contentHtml, board.travel_start_at AS travelStartAt, board.travel_end_at AS travelEndAt, board.status AS status, board.visibility AS visibility, board.category AS category, boardFiles.id AS featureImgId FROM board board LEFT JOIN board_files boardFiles ON board.id = boardFiles.board_id AND boardFiles.type = 'FEATURE' WHERE board.user_id = #{userId} AND board.status = 'DRAFT'
